services_shape: visits of a set length, booked with a family doctor or a nurse practitioner by name; a new patient's first visit is longer and the owner OKs it; same-day sick times open each morning for current patients first; yearly checkups for current patients; follow-ups and fasting labs are booked by the office at checkout, never offered by text or to an AI; other shots are picked by the clinician at the visit, a flu shot can also be booked, and no shot is ever paid up front; a house call has a 2-hour arrival window
questions_before_times: a new or a current patient
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, a child, or another adult
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), fainting, or very heavy bleeding
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
Sam's OK for a new patient
license: always: each family doctor (MD or DO), internist, nurse practitioner, physician assistant and nurse holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit; which roles need which license comes from the state's form (a switch)
staff_skills: family doctors and nurse practitioners: new patients, yearly checkups, sick visits, video visits and house calls; nurses: flu shots and shot-only visits on the clinician's order; home blood work: someone whose license or certificate covers drawing blood; only people cleared for house calls go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, medicines, test results or the clinician's name (at a house call the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
